stock.description: Shiyue Daotian Group Co., Ltd., along with its subsidiaries, specializes in the production and sale of essential household food items across the People's Republic of China. The company's operations are divided into three core divisions: Rice Products; Whole Grain, Bean, and other related goods; and Dried Food and additional offerings. Its diverse product range encompasses various pre-packaged rice varieties; a selection of pre-packaged mixed whole grains such as brown rice, millet, red beans, seeds, corn, and sesame; and dried edibles including wood ear mushrooms, snow fungus mushrooms, and lotus seeds. Additionally, it markets by-products like bran, husk, and fractioned rice. These products are predominantly sold under its well-known brands: Shiyue Daotian, Firewood Courtyard, and Sunshine Family. Established in 2018 and headquartered in Beijing, PRC, the company was formerly known as Shiyue Daotian Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd.
